free_tier.stated: 10 GiB free at signup; Pro I 200 GiB / €1.99 mo, Pro III 2 TiB / €8.99 mo

egress.terms: 'Unlimited bandwidth' on every paid plan; free tier is not bandwidth-metered but is 10 GiB, so egress is not the binding constraint

chaining: The 10 GiB is per account. Separate accounts each held 10 GiB in the past, and Filen closed that: as of the Feb 2026 policy the free 10 GiB is only granted when signup looks like a consumer connection (one-time Ipregistry VPN/proxy classification)
limits_note: 10 GiB unless referred; 'Accounts that do not receive the free 10 GB will also not be eligible for any referral bonuses'; referrals add ~10 GB each up to 30 GB
reliability_note: active, well-maintained service but the several-accounts route is now explicitly detected at signup; a VPN/proxy signup yields an account with zero free storage

evidence.proved: 'Get started with 10 GiB of free space', Pro tiers 200 GiB-10 TiB with 'Unlimited bandwidth'

(published 2026-02-11) — free 10 GB granted only for non-anonymised signup IPs via Ipregistry; 'attempts to create large numbers of free accounts, often through VPNs or proxies, to collect huge amounts of free storage'
